scope: Imported plane degree<=5 automorphism theorem used only for the constant-first weight(1,-1,-3) family over K(a). The theorem is not reproved here.
statement: Every plane Keller pair with both component degrees<=5 is polynomially invertible: degree1 is elementary; degrees2,3,5 use the prime case and degree4 uses Theorem3(2). Apply over K(a), then use the formal inverse over K[a] to clear coefficient denominators.
